validation_samples: All eleven EMseq001 through EMseq011 real mixtures at UMD
truth_source: Local STable.xlsx, Table S7; species aggregated to families only after all predictions finish
primary_prediction_rule: Exact family-evidence-fusion-v1 merged rule; no retraining or cutoff selection on real mixtures
reference_model_training: TTU reference-only species-held-out full-profile verifier; unchanged model and threshold
reused: UMD query exon assemblies and complete per-gene order matching evidence with original native scores
recomputed: Replay uncapped parent selection with distinct-gene votes from full PEA evidence; rebuild family references and full trees for the admitted parents; original distances, C, stability and frozen ML
evaluation: No species-level prediction claim. Retain all S7 true families, including absent parents/references as FN. Review candidates do not count as final positives. No taxonomy correction after results without separate explicit reporting.
independence_scope: The eleven real mixtures were not used to fit or select this reference model/fusion threshold, but were analyzed previously with other pipelines and share the reference resource. No claim of novel species or independent-reference generalization.
preflight_v1: Cancelled before predictions: the previous UMD parent lists were capacity-truncated and some locus counts were exon counts
